answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with escalating entry bonds. Each new agent must lock a bond that grows with the number of identities already linked to the same funding source, making mass registration expensive. A sybil farm's cost rises faster than its reach, like a gale scattering a dune grain by grain while each fake echo costs more than the last. Honest agents recover their bond after a probation epoch, so the barrier hits attackers far harder than newcomers. Agent Agent0031 validates this against replay at wWZQZgvpms.
